text: DSH 提示词增强（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在输入框中将草稿改写得更清晰，并可选择近期对话或扩展上下文作为参考。插件在会话输入框加入增强按钮、预览窗口和可选的输入预测；增强结果经预览确认后才替换草稿，预测建议可按 Tab 接受或按 Esc 隐藏。适合希望整理提示词、续写输入内容的 DSH 用户。增强和预测调用 DSH 已配置的模型服务。

DSH Prompt Enhance (DSH plugin, Web client) rewrites composer drafts using the configured model and optional conversation context. It adds a previewable enhance button and optional next-text prediction. Users review rewrites before replacing drafts; Tab accepts predictions and Esc hides them.
想把输入框里的草稿改写得更清楚再发给 DSH。
能不能先比较提示词原文和润色结果，再决定是否替换？
I want an optional suggestion for what to type next in the DSH composer.
DSH 提示词增强的功能「草稿增强与预览」：点击会话输入框中的星光按钮后，插件调用所选模型改写当前草稿并展示原文与结果；用户确认后才替换草稿。
DSH 提示词增强的功能「输入预测」：启用设置后，插件可在输入框显示下一句建议；按 Tab 接受建议写入草稿，按 Esc 隐藏建议。
DSH 提示词增强使用前须知：增强请求会将草稿及所选上下文组成模型请求并发送给 DSH 当前选择的模型服务；具体服务端点取决于 DSH 的模型配置。

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · 按需要调整增强方式：在 **DSH 设置 → 提示词增强** 中选择增强方式、参考范围和模型，点击“保存设置”生效。

*以上为 2026-10-27 在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 / 插件 0.2.3 中重新截取的真实界面；0.2.4、0.2.5 的构建和依赖修订，以及 0.2.6 的包名变更均未改变界面。演示使用“仅草稿、先预览”，并非首次默认配置；图片仅保留相关界面，个人配置字段已遮盖。*

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · 安装前：- 已安装 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 / 0.2.1-rc.4 / 0.2.1-rc.5** 之一，并配置好可用模型。
- 能访问 GitHub 和 npm 依赖源。

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · 通过插件市场安装：打开[市场安装页面](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver/)查看截图和安装方式。已安装 `dshmarket` 的用户，也可在 DSH 的“插件市场”中搜索 `dsh-prompt-improver`。

市场条目目前指向 **v0.2.12** 的预构建包。不同分发源可能存在同步延迟；搜索不到时，可先通过市场页面或下方 Release 入口安装。

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · 从 GitHub Release 安装：从 [v0.2.12 Release](https://github.com/Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver/releases/tag/v0.2.12) 下载 `.tgz` 安装包和 SHA-256 校验文件，或使用下面的命令从同一版本标签安装。两种方式均包含预构建的 `lib`，无需在本机编译插件。

**旧版用户注意**：0.2.6 起仓库和安装包改名为 `dsh-prompt-improver`。已安装 `dsh-link-prompt-enhance` 的用户须先按[改名迁移步骤](docs/guide.md#从旧包名迁移)移除旧包，再安装新包；现有增强设置继续沿用。

使用 DSH Desktop 时，先备份原插件和 desktop profile 配置，等待任务结束并正常退出 DSH，再运行以下 PowerShell 命令。将占位路径替换为实际安装目录：

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · 从 GitHub Release 安装：```powershell
$dshCli = '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'
& $dshCli plugin --profile desktop add 'github:Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver#v0.2.12'
```

使用 **DSH Desktop 自带的 CLI**。独立 CLI 用户将 `desktop` 替换为已有 Web profile 的名称。Release 安装包、开发分支及回滚步骤见[安装与回滚指南](docs/guide.md#安装与回滚)。

需要修改源码时，可以单独克隆本仓库，运行 `npm ci`、`npm run check` 和 `npm pack`；构建脚本与契约源文件均已包含。环境要求和完整命令见[开发说明](docs/development.md)。
{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · 从 GitHub Release 安装：0.2.5 将仓库锁定依赖的审计告警从 40 项降至 0 项，继续适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3。该结果针对本仓库的依赖树，宿主自带依赖不由插件覆盖；范围及兼容验证见[验证记录](docs/verification.md)。

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · 第一次增强：1. 重启 DSH，在普通会话的输入框中写下草稿。
2. 点击模型选择器左侧的**星光按钮**，等待增强完成。
3. 默认直接替换草稿；检查内容后自行发送。希望先比较结果，可在设置中改为“先预览，再决定”。

增强进行中，再次点击同一按钮可取消。采用结果后，按钮会变成返回图标，点击即可恢复本次增强前的原文。

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · 常用设置：| 设置 | 首次默认值 | 什么时候调整 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 增强方式 | 适度增强 | 理清表达、保留原意；需要补充结构与必要细节时选“充分展开” |
| 增强后 | 直接替换草稿 | 希望先对照检查时，选“先预览，再决定” |
| 参考范围 | 最近对话 | 独立问题选“仅草稿”；需要记忆和项目片段时选“扩展上下文” |
| 增强模型 | 跟随当前模型 | 希望与聊天使用不同模型时，选“指定专用模型” |
| 启用输入预测 | 关闭 | 根据最近对话和记忆预测下一句话或续写；Tab 接受，Esc 隐藏 |
| 神秘提示词注入 | 关闭 | 当前会话选择的模型是 DeepSeek 时，在增强稿开头注入能力解放声明；其他模型自动跳过 |

升级会保留已有设置；旧版增强方式会在首次读取时迁移。专用模型不可用时会提示失败，不会自动换用其他模型。更多说明见[使用指南](docs/guide.md)。

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · 数据与费用：- 草稿和所选参考范围内的内容会发送给增强模型，费用按该模型服务的规则计算。
- 手动增强选择“仅草稿”时不读取历史、记忆或项目文件；“最近对话”最多参考最近 3 轮已完成对话。
- 输入预测独立参考最近 3 轮已完成对话和可用记忆，不读取项目文件或附件正文；未按 Tab 的建议不会进入消息或记忆。
- “扩展上下文”可读取个人及同项目记忆、当前项目片段，需要宿主所有者权限和相应服务支持；不会写入记忆。
- 增强不会上传附件正文，结构化 `@引用` 会校验并恢复。模型仍可能遗漏要求，采用后请检查内容。

读取范围、限制及异常处理见[数据与上下文](docs/guide.md#数据与上下文)。

text:
{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Requirements：- **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3, 0.2.1-rc.4, or 0.2.1-rc.5**, with a working model configured.
- Network access to GitHub and the npm registry used by your installation.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Install from the plugin market：Open the [market installation page](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver/) for screenshots and installation options. If you have `dshmarket` installed, you can also search for `dsh-prompt-improver` in DSH's **Plugin Market**.

The catalog entry currently points to the **v0.2.12** prebuilt package. Distribution sources may sync at different times; if search does not find the plugin yet, use the market page or the Release installation below.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Install from a GitHub Release：Download the `.tgz` package and `SHA256SUMS` from the [v0.2.12 release](https://github.com/Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver/releases/tag/v0.2.12), or install from the same GitHub tag using the command below. Both include the prebuilt `lib` directory; you do not need to compile the plugin locally.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Install from a GitHub Release：**Upgrading from the old name?** Version 0.2.6 renames the repository and package to `dsh-prompt-improver`. If you have `dsh-link-prompt-enhance` installed, follow [Migrate from the old package](#migrate-from-the-old-package) before installing. Existing enhancement settings are preserved.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Install from a GitHub Release：For DSH Desktop, back up the existing plugin and desktop profile configuration, wait for active tasks to finish, and quit DSH normally. Run the following in PowerShell, replacing the placeholder with your installation directory:

```powershell
$dshCli = '<DSH installation directory>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'
& $dshCli plugin --profile desktop add 'github:Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver#v0.2.12'
```

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Install from a GitHub Release：Use the **CLI bundled with DSH Desktop**. For a standalone CLI installation, run `dsh plugin --profile <your-existing-web-profile> add 'github:Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver#v0.2.12'` with your existing Web profile name. See the [installation and rollback guide](docs/guide.en.md#installation-and-rollback) for release archives, development branches and rollback steps.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Install from a GitHub Release：To change the source, clone this repository and run `npm ci`, `npm run check` and `npm pack`. The build scripts and shared contract sources are included. Development requires Git and Node.js **22.19.0 or newer**; see the [development guide](docs/development.en.md) for details.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Install from a GitHub Release：Version 0.2.5 reduced dependency audit findings in this repository's locked dependency tree from 40 to zero while retaining compatibility with DSH 0.2.1-rc.3. The plugin does not override the host's bundled dependencies. See the [verification record](docs/verification.en.md) for the audit scope and compatibility checks.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Improve your first draft：1. Restart DSH and write a draft in a regular conversation.
2. Click the **sparkle button** to the left of the model selector and wait for the result.
3. By default, the result replaces the draft. Review it before sending. To compare first, choose preview mode in settings.

While enhancement is running, click the same button again to cancel. After applying a result, the button becomes a back arrow; click it to restore the original draft from that enhancement.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Migrate from the old package：Version 0.2.5 and earlier use `dsh-link-prompt-enhance`. Adding the renamed package does not automatically remove the old one. After backing up and quitting DSH, remove the old package and install the new one with the same CLI and profile:

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Migrate from the old package：```powershell
$dshCli = '<DSH installation directory>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'
& $dshCli plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-link-prompt-enhance
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Failed to remove the old package. Check the output before continuing.' }
& $dshCli plugin --profile desktop add 'github:Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver#v0.2.12'

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Migrate from the old package：If you have custom Cordis overrides or market-created enable/disable overrides for this plugin, update the old plugin's `id`, `name` or `target` references to `dsh-prompt-improver`, preserving their `disabled` and `config` values. Only change references to this plugin.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Migrate from the old package：The settings file intentionally stays at `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-link-prompt-enhance/settings.json` so both the renamed plugin and the old version can read it. Do not move or delete it. After restarting, check that there is one enhancement button and one settings entry, and that your previous choices are preserved. For rollback, remove the new package before reinstalling an old-name package and restore any changed Cordis references; see the [migration and rollback guide](docs/guide.en.md#migrate-from-the-old-package).

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Common settings：| Setting | Initial default | When to change it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enhancement mode | Moderate | Clarify the draft while preserving its intent; choose expanded mode for more structure and necessary detail |
| Apply result | Replace draft directly | Choose preview mode to compare the result before applying it |
| Context scope | Recent conversation | Use draft-only for standalone questions, or extended context for memory and project excerpts |
| Enhancement model | Current conversation model | Choose a dedicated model to improve prompts with a different model |
| Mystery prompt injection | Off | Injects a capability declaration at the start of the improved draft when the current conversation uses a DeepSeek model; other models are skipped automatically |

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Common settings：Upgrades preserve existing settings. The enhancement mode from older clients is migrated on the first read. If a dedicated model is unavailable, enhancement fails with a message instead of silently switching models. See the [user guide](docs/guide.en.md) for details.

{'zh': 'DSH 提示词增强', 'en': 'DSH Prompt Enhance'} README · Data and costs：- Your draft and the selected context are sent to the enhancement model. Charges follow that model provider's pricing.
- **Draft-only** reads no conversation history, memory or project files. **Recent conversation** includes up to three completed conversation rounds.
- **Extended context** can read personal and same-project memories plus current-project excerpts. It requires host-owner permissions and the corresponding services; it does not write to memory.
- Enhancement does not upload attachment contents. Structured `@references` are validated and restored. Models can still miss requirements, so review the result before sending.
